def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    # Select separator rows/columns: mostly background, with at least one marker.
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v != bg for v in grid[r]) > 0
            and sum(v == bg for v in grid[r]) >= w * 0.7]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] != bg for r in rows)
            and sum(grid[r][c] == bg for r in range(h)) >= h * 0.7]
    if not rows or not cols:
        return [[bg]]
    a = [[grid[r][c] for c in cols] for r in rows]
    # Keep the marker-bearing rectangle.
    rr = [i for i, row in enumerate(a) if any(v != bg for v in row)]
    cc = [j for j in range(len(cols)) if any(a[i][j] != bg for i in range(len(rows)))]
    a = [a[i][min(cc):max(cc)+1] for i in range(min(rr), max(rr)+1)]
    # Repeated neighboring rows/columns represent the same enlarged cell.
    a = [row for i, row in enumerate(a) if i == 0 or row != a[i-1]]
    keep = [j for j in range(len(a[0])) if j == 0 or any(row[j] != row[j-1] for row in a)]
    return [[row[j] for j in keep] for row in a]
